name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a single high-contrast skip link at the top of every page that only appears when keyboard focus arrives. This guarantees keyboard users bypass repetitive blocks in one jump, fixing the most common navigation failure without cluttering the visual design. The trade-off is a tiny extra DOM node and a focused state style, both negligible compared to the universal benefit.

name: Reader
text: Risk: Hiding the skip link until first tab press means screen-reader users who rely on virtual cursors never see it—so they still slog through blocks. Better: always show the skip link but style it off-screen until focus arrives. Settle with testing: run a screen-reader user through both versions and measure time to reach main content.
